title: Leaving, Staying, or Living There? Duration Commonsense Reasoning with Human-LLM Co-annotations
abstract: arXiv:2610.38755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gardening in the backyard implies living there, while checking into an Airbnb more likely means staying for a few days. Such duration judgments are important for understanding human mobility, travel behavior, and social context. However, duration is rarely stated explicitly in social media posts and must instead be inferred from noisy textual, visual, and contextual cues. In this paper, we investigate whether vision-language models possess such duration commonsense. We create a new corpus of geotagged tweets co-annotated by humans and LLMs to serve as a testbed for this task. We find that state-of-the-art models struggle with duration inference, even when guided by multi-turn Chain-of-Thought prompting. Error analyses further reveal that models often fail to integrate critical contextual information, or they overly rely on prominent visual details while overlooking subtle hashtags and semantic nuances. translated_title: 离开、暂住还是定居？基于人类与大语言模型协同标注的时长常识推理
translated_abstract: 在后院做园艺意味着居住在那里，而入住爱彼迎（Airbnb）则更可能表示只停留几天。这类时长判断对于理解人类流动、旅行行为和社会情境非常重要。然而，时长在社交媒体帖子中很少被明确表述，而必须从嘈杂的文本、视觉和上下文线索中推断。在本文中，我们研究视觉-语言模型是否具备这种时长常识。我们构建了一个由人类和大语言模型协同标注的带地理标记的推文新语料库，作为该任务的测试平台。我们发现最先进的模型在时长推断上表现不佳，即使是在多轮思维链提示的引导下也是如此。错误分析进一步揭示，模型往往无法整合关键的上下文信息，或者过度依赖显著的视觉细节，而忽视细微的话题标签和语义差别。这些发现强调了该任务的挑战性以及改进模型时长常识推理能力的必要性。
tldr: 本文构建了首个由人类与大语言模型协同标注的地理标记推文语料库来检验模型的时长常识推理能力，发现即使借助多轮思维链提示，最先进的视觉-语言模型在推断“离开、暂住还是定居”时依然表现不佳，常因无法整合关键上下文或过度依赖显著视觉细节而犯错。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel human-LLM co-annotated corpus of geotagged tweets to test duration commonsense reasoning, revealing that state-of-the-art vision-language models—despite multi-turn Chain-of-Thought prompting—struggle to infer whether people are leaving, staying, or living somewhere due to failures in contextual integration and over-reliance on salient visual details.
